title: Deep learning enables satellite-based monitoring of large populations of terrestrial mammals across heterogeneous landscape
summary: Nearly 500,000 wildebeest and zebra were counted across heterogeneous satellite imagery with reported precision, recall and F1. The result is bounded to the studied Serengeti-Mara ecosystem and imagery; performance in other species or regions is not established.
ai_technology: A U-Net ensemble produces satellite-image probability maps and K-means converts detections into individual ungulates.
organization: Department of Natural Resources, Faculty of Geo-Information Science and Earth Observation, University of Twente, Enschede, The Netherlands
